name: Westfield Topanga
description: Westfield Topanga is a premier upscale shopping destination in the San Fernando Valley, featuring luxury boutiques including Prada, Balenciaga, Saint Laurent, and Rolex alongside popular retailers. The center offers exceptional dining experiences with STK Steakhouse, JINYA Ramen Bar, and the newly opened Chubby Cattle, plus entertainment options including AMC Theatres and seasonal events. With its sophisticated mix of high-end fashion, dining, and entertainment, Westfield Topanga provides an elevated shopping experience with modern amenities including 27 EV charging stations.
summary: An upscale regional mall in the San Fernando Valley featuring luxury fashion brands, premium dining, and entertainment venues in a modern shopping environment.
